name: Dorfstadl
beschreibung:
The family-run Gasthof Dorfstadl welcomes visitors to the popular village of Koessen with rustic charm and hearty hospitality. Pleasant guest rooms and a traditional dining parlour serving regional delicacies ensure a comfortable stay.

Framed by the rugged Kaiser peaks, it provides an ideal starting point for hiking, paragliding off the Unterberghorn, swimming in Lake Walchsee, and winter cross-country skiing.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Dorfstadl in Koessen offers cosy rooms and authentic Tyrolean alpine hospitality in the Kaiserwinkl region.
